Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental conceptual error regarding the definition and consequences of somatic cell mutations. Specifically, the agent incorrectly stated that somatic mutations are "not passed on to offspring" as a reason to rule out option C (leading to tumors), whereas the correct logic is that somatic mutations are not passed to offspring (ruling out D), but they *do* cause harm within the organism by leading to uncontrolled cell growth and tumors (supporting C). The agent confused the mechanism of harm (tumors) with the mechanism of inheritance (germline transmission), leading to the selection of the incorrect option D instead of the correct option C.
